headline: Approved October 7 meeting minutes as amended, clarifying Cal Shepard made contact with Korean Veterans representatives.
summary: Agenda items included reports, a protocol manual, and term limits. The minutes do not say how the item on 2027 annual meeting dates ended.
decisions: Approved the October 7 meeting minutes as amended.

decision_evidence.quote: The previous meeting minutes were approved as amended.
